messages:
jules: quick sync request — SI partner wants a reproducible airgapped demo for OTLP traces that we can ship on a USB. ask: single tarball with collector, seed traces, and a one-click installer + dashboard JSON. anyone seen this before?

nina: saw something similar with another partner. main gotcha: cert provisioning and making sure the collector can write to a local file sink and then later upload when network is re-enabled. we should include a verifier that checks trace counts locally.

arjun: agree. propose layout: /collector/bin, /config/otel.yaml, /demo/traces.jsonl, /tools/seed.sh, /tools/upload.sh, /docs/README.md. seed.sh will replay traces to localhost:4317.

matt: on the datadog side we need mapping for service.name + team tag so the screenshots align with marketplace tile. i'll export a dashboard JSON with variables.

jules: marketing/PR note: we must not use real customer data — only synthetic traces. nina, can you ensure the seed generator strips any PII and produces deterministic trace IDs for screenshots?

nina: yes — default mode will redact attributes and set deterministic IDs. command: `python tools/generate_synthetic.py --count 200 --deterministic`

arjun: ops checklist addition: include a perf smoke test that sends a burst of 2500 spans and verifies collector export queue stays below threshold. simple script: `./tools/perf_smoke.sh --spans 2500`

matt: dashboard will show trace latency histogram, top ops, and a small table with `redwood.partner:airgap-demo`. i'll attach the dashboard JSON to the bundle.

jules: legal/embargo? i don't want accidental leaks before joint announcement. we'll gate release behind partner signoff. sara from comms will we need a partner NDA snippet in the README?

ops-bot: reminder: created doc https://redwood-internal/partnerships/airgap-otel-demo and calendar placeholder "Airgap OTLP Demo Review" on Mon 2pm PT. edit access: jules, nina, arjun, matt. :white_check_mark:

nina: timeline: aim to have the first bundle by Fri COB for internal review, partner preview next Tue. is that ok?
arjun: yes. i'll produce the tarball + quick install script by Thu so we have time to test.
matt: i'll post the dashboard JSON and a short gif of the demo UI to the doc by Fri.
jules: action owners: nina=seed generator & redaction, arjun=bundle + installer, matt=dashboard + tags, jules=partner liaise + embargo. drop any blockers in the doc under "DAY-OF RISKS". thanks all. :rocket:
